scope: Typed Entry Fabric causal event/admission identity, HCU router policy/engine/route identity, GRID10 plan identity, and downstream inference receipt identity

authority_source.law: Explicit current-main selection and newer append-only corrections govern current work selection. Historical receipts and hashes retain their original schema/source scope and are never rewritten in place.

current_implementation_split.typed_entry_event_admission: RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 directly via entry_canonicalization_v1.py under ENTITYOS_HCU_ENTRY_EVENT_IDENTITY/v2 and ENTITYOS_HCU_ENTRY_ADMISSION_IDENTITY/v2
current_implementation_split.typed_entry_compatibility_import: typed_entry_canonical_v1.py delegates to the same RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 implementation and retains the historical CBOR schema name only as provenance metadata
current_implementation_split.grid10_plan_encoder: RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 through the typed_entry_canonical_v1 compatibility adapter; GridPlan still requires its identity schema/version migration to be explicit before promotion
current_implementation_split.law: This is a partial source migration, not end-to-end acceptance. Router/engine/route and inference identity still block one-schema promotion. Existing historical CBOR and Python-json hashes are not reinterpreted.

grid10_plan_identity_must_bind: entry_admission_sha256 or its explicitly admitted relation when plan semantics are admission-specific
downstream_inference_receipt_must_echo: grid_plan_sha256 when execution used a plan

bounded_source_delta.effect: GRID10 and compatibility imports no longer retain an active CBOR encoder; Entry event/admission was already independently migrated to JCS/v2 on the refreshed retained parent

remaining_gates_before_source_promotion: give GRID10 plan identity an explicit new versioned schema while retaining historical plan hashes at original scope
wire RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 into router policy, EngineAdmission identity and route identity under new versioned identities
wire RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 into downstream inference receipt hashing and echo under a new versioned receipt identity
reject mixed, unknown and downgraded canonicalization versions fail closed across Entry Route GridPlan and Inference
retain raw JSON duplicate-name, nonfinite-number and lone-surrogate rejection before ordinary Mapping construction
run exact-current combined Entry+router+inference+canonicalization+GRID10 regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated executor
rebase and fuse settled retained mechanisms onto current EntityOS/HCU main without duplicate authority
bind real loader-consumed checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime/build bytes, capability record and measured capacity receipt before physical model runtime promotion
rebuild compatibility package only after source and loader identities settle
note: This delta closes one source split by making the compatibility/GRID10 encoder path converge on current-main RFC8785 authority. It does not claim router/inference migration, exact current integrated execution, loader attestation, HCU runtime acceptance or whole EntityOS PASS.
